notes: This PASS applies to32 original artworks plus six administrative status pages and the gallery. It does not upgrade any held original artwork.
Four held directories contain only index.html and provenance.json in this proposal. Original artwork and response records remain preserved in the original workspace.
Provenance distinguishes publication status review_held from generation_status generated and preserves each original REVIEW score/hash.
All32 displayed artworks are byte-identical to independently approved original-model output. No model artwork was edited by the reviewer.
Gallery search/family filtering,empty-state behavior,project-prefix relative links,keyboard provenance toggles and JSON-record links passed.
The isolated proposal has not been published. Quality PASS does not supply the still-pending user choice about publication scope.
